I couldn't reccomend more highly. Very professional service (teeth clean and polish, consultation and casts for a mandibular advancement device).
All costs were itemised in advance without prompting, and were competitive compared to other practices. Rigorous hygiene as you would anticipate in these times. 10 out of 10. Thanks! 🙏

Went in to get a quote for Invisalign and ended up with a bill for 4,850 baht.  This left a very sour taste in our mouth so I decided to go to another dentist.  I'd recommend to anyone to ask for all the costs upfront before you speak to any of their dentists.
